crossRefs.note: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

translations.web: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
translations.bsb: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.
translations.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
translations.asv: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of skilful workmanship.
